div.div: 7 اِنْصِرَادٌ is said to mean The experiencing of cold. (Meyd. [Mentioned by him, with the expression of a doubt as to the true meaning, and as only occurring, to his knowledge, in a prov., which see in Freytag's “ Arab. Prov. ” i. 357: but أَكَامٍ, there, should be إِكَامٍ.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
